source: 110 CapCut drafts (148 text elements in 89 drafts; 35 joined to posted reels). See STYLE_GUIDE.md

then_vs_now_multi_card.cards: one card per era; switch exactly on body cuts; 'Vs..'/'VS' bridge card

long_two_line_hook.note: BrickHood quoted hooks with 26-28 chars/line use scale ~0.72-0.75 so both lines fit 82% width

payoff_card.note: later cards sometimes drop lower (22-27% from top) to clear the product

variants.rare_outliers: 8 cards with no stroke, 1 black-on-white; all flops or unposted → do not use

render.font_note: CapCut SystemFont en.ttf is not on the box; Montserrat Medium (OFL) matched glyph shapes (double-storey a, 2/4 shapes) and width/height ratio (0.0926 vs measured 0.0902; Poppins has single-storey a; TikTok Sans 0.105). Visual overlay on 3 posted reels matched size, wrap, position.
render.font_px_formula: font_px = 0.00557 * font_size * scale * frame_width  (=0.0776*W at size 15, scale 0.93)
render.position_formula: text block centre y_px = (1 - transform_y)/2 * H; x_px = (1 + transform_x)/2 * W
render.emoji_font_box: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoColorEmoji.ttf (CapCut on Mac renders Apple Color Emoji; glyph art differs, size/position match)
render.renderer: style/render_text.py: render_card(text, W, H, scale, y) -> RGBA layer; burn via ffmpeg overlay. ffmpeg drawtext cannot draw colour emoji, so render the PNG layer with PIL and composite: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -i card.png -filter_complex "[0][1]overlay=0:0:enable='between(t,T0,T1)'"

ffmpeg_drawtext_fallback.note: no emoji; use only when PIL unavailable

video_edit_defaults.speed: 1.0 on 89.5% of clips; speed-ups 1.1-1.6x on 10%, mostly body action clips
video_edit_defaults.clip_audio: kept at 1.0 (79%), muted on 13% of clips (song-only moments), boosted 1.3-3.4x on 8% (SFX moments)
video_edit_defaults.adjustment_layer: optional whole-timeline adjust in 18/110 drafts: brightness +0.02, saturation +0.08, temperature -0.08..-0.28 (cooler), tone -0.08, light_sensation +0.06..0.08

music_volume.note: Last Christmas / Bublé / Mariah placed at 1.0; some 2.0-2.6 boosts; no fades (0/171 audio segments)
